For artists

Track your demos and releases in one place.

Stop DMing staff to ask "any update?". Log in with your Discord account and see the status of every submission and release you've sent to any Vektra label — In Queue, Shortlisted, Approved, or shipped.

  • One login, all labels you've submitted to
  • Live status on demos, shortlists, and decisions
  • Release request tracking through QC
  • Decision DMs mirrored on the web

For labels & collectives

A&R, support, and delivery — without the spreadsheets.

Vektra runs per-server so each label keeps its own branding, staff channel, and storage. Pro and Pro+ unlock analytics, message broadcasting, white-label bots, and release delivery.

  • Demo intake with AI spam checks and cooldowns
  • Branded submit & ticket panels, DM templates
  • Managed regions or your own Neon/Postgres
  • Release QC delivery with staff review threads
